text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah...!
Emperor! Emperor! Emperor! Emperor!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun...
These cheers are...
choice_data_list: This is a tribute to you, who stands at the pinnacle.
This is a tribute to you, who stands at the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see...
So, I was victorious.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Did you get a little too carried away?
That's not like you, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The girlish version of you
is pretty cool too, though♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was only because I raced against you that I could lose myself in the moment.
Because you are strong... it was truly fun.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, stop it. Saying such nice things
to the person you just beat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Allow me to correct myself, then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Slaying the monster felt truly invigorating.
Thank you, Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
*Faceplants*!
Wait, hang on, is that really okay!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry about that.
Just a joke.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Sheesh.
I'll forgive you just this once, considering that carefree smile of yours.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Farewell then, "Emperor."
—Let your guard down, and I'll swallow you whole next time♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Next, huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... Next time, she likely
won't run the way she did today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's a strange feeling.
I was completely absorbed in just running.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This is a race where one cannot expect to win without exerting every ounce of tactical genius and relentless effort.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet I was simply enjoying myself.
The wind, the battle for position, and running itself...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, it was fun, very much so.
It truly was a delightful race...”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's because you pushed me forward.
To just run as myself, being true to who I am.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It reminded me once again of that primal urge that makes Umamusume want to race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Races are delightful.
Beyond the finish line, happiness awaits.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want every Umamusume to feel that joy.
That is why... I will show them the ideal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We must dedicate ourselves even further toward our ideals.
And for that, your cooperation is essential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
After all, Umamusume aren't the only ones
who can make the charm of racing known.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Will you still indulge this whimsical dream of mine, Trainer?

That expression filled with determination
was proof that the true "Emperor" Symboli Rudolf
had been born right here.
(*Snap! Snap! Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf-san!!
Please tell us how you're feeling right now...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the reporters are calling for me.
Perfect timing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, gather all the reporters.
—We shall hold a press conference.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—My friends... Please allow me
to address you as such.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have come here today as the "Emperor"
to speak of my dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to create a world
where every Umamusume can find happiness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
People sneer in contempt.
It is impossible for “everyone” to find happiness.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
People scoff.
What could a single person possibly achieve on their own?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
People look down on me.
No one would ever follow an immature king.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I worked relentlessly day and night
to overcome everything all on my own.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—However, that was a mistake.
At last, I have attained the truth.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I cannot bring happiness to "everyone."
Therefore, I will believe in the will of each and every individual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
One cannot accomplish anything alone.
Therefore, I put my trust in the comrades I rely on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No one will follow an immature king.
Therefore... I must believe in myself and forge ahead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――Now then. To those beyond the screen, beyond the words,
and to those I shall one day meet face-to-face: hear this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am Symboli Rudolf. Right now, I am the "Emperor" who stands at the very pinnacle of all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I swear upon the crowns I have stacked high
to remain forever faithful to all of your dreams.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Those who are prepared to seize glory,
gather before me."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —I welcome you.
